newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ sees improved full year result.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ sees improved full year result.

text.p: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd (ANZ) said on Wednesday it expected an improved result for the full year but saw slower growth in the second half.

"I would be hesitant to say, but we are looking for improvement," ANZ chief executive Don Mercer told a news conference when asked whether ANZ could repeat its 24 percent pre-abnormal half year profit growth over the full year.
ANZ chief financial officer David Craig told the news confererence it would be difficult for ANZ's Australian operation to repeat first half profit growth of over 30 percent.

"It would be very tough to say 30 percent in the second half," Craig said. Craig also said pre-emptive mortgage rate cuts earlier in the year would have taken about 10 basis points off ANZ's group interest margin of 3.1 percent as at March 31.
